data.text: Paper “Method-Level Bug Prediction: How Far Are We?” submitted to ICSE 2027 (Research Track) — currently under review.
Paper “How Do Agentic AI Systems Deal With Software Energy Concerns?” accepted at MSR 2026 (Challenge Track).
Placed 2nd (team) at the Safe Food For Canada hackathon, hosted by the University of Manitoba and the University of Guelph.
Began the M.Sc. in Computer Science at the University of Manitoba, joining the SQM Research Lab under Dr. Shaiful Chowdhury.
Joined East Delta University as a Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.
